name: vibe-sec
description: Vibe Sec — canary channel. Tracks the main branch of the solo repo. For stable releases pinned to tagged versions, install via the aggregated 626Labs marketplace at github.com/estevanhernandez-stack-ed/vibe-plugins.

plugins.name: vibe-sec
plugins.description: Security gap finder for vibe-coded apps — the tier-aware audit and orchestration layer that defers to gitleaks/OSV-Scanner/Semgrep when present and falls back to an in-house baseline when absent. Early access (v0.2.0 foundation): secret scan + tier classification live; the full 10-concern audit, fix engine, and threat-model land across upcoming releases.
